instruction: I need to de-emphasize the last paragraph in this course outline document. Please apply italic formatting to all text in the final paragraph.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires applying italic formatting to all text in the last paragraph. The evaluator checks if all runs in the last paragraph have italic=True. Verified by reading the document structure - last paragraph exists at index 4.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement: checks that all text in the last paragraph has italic formatting
Metric logic is semantically correct: loads docx file, gets last paragraph, verifies all non-empty runs have italic=True
Postconfig appropriately saves the document (Ctrl+S) to ensure file state is persisted before verification
Getter correctly retrieves the modified .docx file from the VM
Metric handles edge cases: empty document, empty paragraph, and skips whitespace-only runs
Complete coverage: verifies ALL text runs in the last paragraph, not just some
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: The strict window name matching in postconfig could fail if window title has unsaved indicator (*). Consider using strict=false or partial matching if this becomes an issue.
Minor: The metric skips runs with only whitespace (run.text.strip()). This is reasonable but could be documented more explicitly in the function docstring.
